sanskrit_verse: दर्पाद् वा यदि वा मोहाच्छलाघया वा स्वयं वदेत्‌ । ममैषा भुक्तपूर्वेति सर्वं संग्रहणं स्मृतम् ॥
transliteration: darpād vā yadi vā mohāc chalāghayā vā svayaṃ vadet | mamaiṣā bhuktapūrveti sarvaṃ saṃgrahaṇaṃ smṛtam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When one speaks out of arrogance, delusion, or deceit, claiming prior ownership of what has already been consumed, all such grasping is to be recognized as unlawful seizure.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from alignment with factual reality, not assertion
Causation is traced to the motive of greed, delusion, or pride
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by awareness of prior consumption
Restoration logic requires acknowledgment of misappropriation and release of false claim
Consciousness alignment occurs through surrendering deceptive self-positioning
executable_legal_axioms: IF a claimant asserts ownership of a resource after its prior consumption IS known, THEN invalidate the claim automatically.
IF speech originates from darpād (arrogance), mohāt (delusion), or chalāghayā (deceit), THEN trigger mandatory disclosure protocol.
IF a party falsely declares 'this was mine' without evidence of retained entitlement, THEN initiate restorative reintegration process.
IF any act of appropriation bypasses factual verification, THEN flag for consciousness-realization audit.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, claims based on inflated ego, cognitive distortion, or strategic deception must be nullified ex officio. The court's duty is to restore factual integrity, not validate performative assertions rooted in error or vanity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies the root distortion in perception that led to wrongful assertion. Anupūrvaśaḥ traces the sequential emergence of false identity with the object. Responsibility aligns proportionally with the degree of conscious deviation. The corrective path avoids punitive measures, focusing instead on realigning the actor with truth-consciousness.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Require full acknowledgment of prior usage and relinquishment of residual claim.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Facilitate self-recognition of distorted motivation without external accusation.
Capacity Restoration: Reconnect individual with inner discernment capacity to prevent future misalignment.
Integrity Reintegration: Guide return to harmonious participation within collective dharmic order.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness stands as the ultimate adjudicator.
